## Issue

Closes #N / Refs #N

Use Closes only for a complete resolution. For partial work, use Refs and record the
remaining acceptance items on the issue. A child change does not close its tracker.

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant design/oracle evidence.

## Validation

Record checks run and their results, independent review and any remaining limitations.
Keep private infrastructure details out of the PR. Full preflight and applicable CI
must pass before a merge commit; verify the result on main and the issue state.
